sloka: स्थापयित्वा प्रियम् पुत्रम् राज्ञा दशरथेन यः ।मन्द वीर्यः सुतो ज्येष्ठः ततः प्रस्थापितो वनम् ॥३-४८-१५॥
transliteration: sthāpayitvā priyam putram rājñā daśarathena yaḥ ।manda vīryaḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ tataḥ prasthāpito vanam ॥3-48-15॥

translations.english: Considering the eldest son a weakling, king Dasaratha has sent him away to the forest so that he could consecrate his dear son(Bharata).
